name: Saharsa
pointBasis: Immutable pending-queue WUP 2025 City_Code 11339 coordinate, copied without adjustment.
registryBasis: The official Saharsa district revenue pages link to Bihar land records, and the official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms department links to Bhu-Naksha. The district-specific BhuNaksha service returned Saharsa administrative selections and a public cadastral map extent.
blocker: Bihar BhuNaksha exposes a public raster map/WMS viewer and safe parcel identifiers, but the inspected anonymous REST responses did not return GeoJSON or other full parcel polygon geometry. The exact WUP point was not submitted to the local projected-coordinate endpoint and was not shifted to force a hit.
